We are  recruiting to fill the position below:
Job Position: Business Developer

Job Location: No. 14 Lanre Awolokun phase 2, Gbagada estate, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Walk-in interviews on Wednesday and Thursday from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM

  "description": "Prestigious Homes Limited is a luxury home builder, delivering homes to their owners just the way they envisioned it. We create incredible majestic homes with superior craftsmanship, exquisite architectural designs, and the finest interior finishing.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Project Quantity Surveyor / Procurement

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Prestigious Homes Limited (PHL) is seeking a competent and experienced Quantity Surveyor / Procurement Officer to support the Company&#39;s construction and property development operations.
	The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of construction costing, quantity surveying, procurement and supplier management.


Responsibilities


	Prepare and review Bills of Quantities, estimates and material requirements.
	Obtain and compare quotations from suppliers and vendors.
	Source construction materials, equipment and services at competitive prices.
	Prepare purchase requests, purchase orders and procurement documentation.
	Monitor material prices and supplier performance.
	Conduct quantity and cost checks on materials required for projects.
	Support project budgeting, cost control and valuation.
	Verify delivered quantities and specifications against approved requirements.
	Maintain accurate procurement and cost records.
	Coordinate with Project, Site, Finance, Stores and other relevant teams.
	Ensure procurement is carried out in accordance with approved Company processes.
	Identify opportunities for cost savings without compromising quality.
	Perform other relevant QS/procurement duties as assigned.


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s degree/HND in Quantity Surveying, Procurement, Construction Management or a related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in construction, real estate or a related industry.
	Strong knowledge of construction materials, pricing and procurement processes.
	Ability to prepare estimates, BOQs and cost comparisons.
	Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
	Good Excel and reporting skills.
	Strong attention to detail and numerical ability.
	Ability to work with project and site teams and meet deadlines.
	Professional certification/membership is an advantage.


Salary&nbsp;


	Open for Negotiation


Method of Application&nbsp;
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: hr@prestigioushomeslimited.com&nbsp; cc&nbsp;damilola.ikudehinbu@prestigioushomeslimited.com using Job Position as the subject of the mail.",

Project Quantity Surveyor / Procurement Job at Prestigious Homes Limited




        
    

        
        Prestigious Homes Limited is a luxury home builder, delivering homes to their owners just the way they envisioned it. We create incredible majestic homes with superior craftsmanship, exquisite architectural designs, and the finest interior finishing.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Project Quantity Surveyor / Procurement

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

        



     (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({});
    
    




	Prestigious Homes Limited (PHL) is seeking a competent and experienced Quantity Surveyor / Procurement Officer to support the Company's construction and property development operations.
	The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of construction costing, quantity surveying, procurement and supplier management.


Responsibilities


	Prepare and review Bills of Quantities, estimates and material requirements.
	Obtain and compare quotations from suppliers and vendors.
	Source construction materials, equipment and services at competitive prices.
	Prepare purchase requests, purchase orders and procurement documentation.
	Monitor material prices and supplier performance.
	Conduct quantity and cost checks on materials required for projects.
	Support project budgeting, cost control and valuation.
	Verify delivered quantities and specifications against approved requirements.
	Maintain accurate procurement and cost records.
	Coordinate with Project, Site, Finance, Stores and other relevant teams.
	Ensure procurement is carried out in accordance with approved Company processes.
	Identify opportunities for cost savings without compromising quality.
	Perform other relevant QS/procurement duties as assigned.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree/HND in Quantity Surveying, Procurement, Construction Management or a related field.
	Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in construction, real estate or a related industry.
	Strong knowledge of construction materials, pricing and procurement processes.
	Ability to prepare estimates, BOQs and cost comparisons.
	Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
	Good Excel and reporting skills.
	Strong attention to detail and numerical ability.
	Ability to work with project and site teams and meet deadlines.
	Professional certification/membership is an advantage.


Salary 


	Open for Negotiation


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected]  cc [email protected] using Job Position as the subject of the mail.

With pride, we believe we are on a journey to building a legacy rooted in trust, innovation, and exceptional standards riding on our partnership with Samsung, Royal Electronics, Panasonic, Philips, Beko, Kenwood, Powermatic, and many others. Our values continue to guide us, allowing SIMS Nigeria Limited to thrive in a constantly evolving market while delivering lasting value to our customers, partners, and people across Nigeria. With premium products and unmatched service, we are honored to represent these trusted brands in Nigeria, bringing innovation and quality products directly to our customers with the sole aim of enriching their lives. As we continue to expand and adapt to meet the growing needs of our market, SIMS Nigeria Limited remains committed to setting the standard in product quality and service across the nation.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Assistant Accountant

Job Locations: Amuwo Odofin - Lagos, Onitsha - Anambra and Enugu
Employment Type: Full-time

Role Overview


	The Assistant Branch Accountantis responsible for branch accounting, financial controls, reconciliations, and cash operations.


Key Responsibilities
GL &amp; Controllership:


	Post and reconcile daily transactions, including bank, AR/AP, and accrual accounts.
	Support month-end close, tax documentation, three-way matching, variance analysis, and escalation of control issues.


Cash Operations:


	Receive, record, reconcile, and safeguard customer/dealer payments through cash, POS, and bank transfers.
	Balance daily collections, prepare deposit/cash reports, and maintain complete audit trails.


Fixed Assets:


	Maintain the branch fixed asset register, including tagging, depreciation, location, movements, and disposals.
	Support physical counts and CapEx/CWIP accounting.


Accounts Payable &amp; Vendors:


	Verify invoices against POs and goods receipts and process approved payments with proper documentation.
	Reconcile vendor accounts and flag duplicate, incorrect, or suspicious transactions.


Control &amp; Compliance:


	Enforce segregation of duties and safeguard cash, financial records, and supporting documents.
	Support audits, corporate accounting policies, monthly variance reporting, and fraud/control issue escalation.


Odoo Accounting:


	Process and reconcile GL, AP, Fixed Assets, and POS transactions in Odoo.
	Maintain master data, cost-center coding, access controls, and escalate system issues; Inventory is excluded.


Service &amp; Performance:


	Respond to Finance/HQ queries promptly and meet reconciliation and D+5 month-end deadlines.
	Attend required daily/weekly Finance reviews and support cash-security coverage when needed.


Qualifications &amp; Experience


	B.Sc. / HND qualification in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field; ICAN Intermediate preferred.
	Minimum of 3 years of relevant accounting/finance experience with GL, reconciliations, AP, cash management, Excel, and ERP/Odoo systems.
	Female candidates are most preferred.


Method of Application&nbsp;

  "description": "The Simba Group, founded in Nigeria in 1988, is a conglomerate with operations across Nigeria&rsquo;s most dynamic economic sectors. The Group commands leadership positions in all five companies that share a simple, yet effective, corporate vision: providing the customer with unparalleled satisfaction.

The Group has businesses operating in a number of sectors critical to Nigeria&rsquo;s sustained development: agriculture, alternative energy, backup power supply systems, networking and data transmission, ICT infrastructure development, and commercial vehicles sales and servicing. We operate a network oftenbranches, ensuring the availability of our products and services throughout Nigeria, with our reach extending to the remotest corners of the country.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Title: Brand Manager - 2 and 3 Wheeler Automobile
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
